Name: Saurianne's Marvelous Mythicals
Author: saurianne
Description:
[size=3]I originally made these guys for Krobus's June Modjam contest, but because a. I got sick and b. the code was A Mess, I didn't get it out on time. Now that I'm better and the code's been cleaned up, here it is for all of you to enjoy.

This pack adds four species of mythical creatures for you to enjoy, two barn and two coop, each with unique (and probably a little OP) produce. As of the latest update, they should only drop their produce at certain times of year and/or weather:

[/size][list]
[*][size=3][b]Unicorns[/b] live in the deluxe barn and are the most expensive at 25000g. They produce [b]Lunar Essence [/b]in the winter, which sells for 1600g; and [b]Unicorn Fur[/b] on windy days, which sells for 3000g.[/size]
[*][size=3][b]Giant Snails[/b], inspired by the ones knights often fight in illuminated texts,[b] [/b]live in the deluxe barn cost 18000g. They produce two items: [b]Snail Eggs[/b] in the fall, which sell for 1800g; and [b]Snail Dye[/b] on rainy days in fall and spring, which sells for 2000g. The snails come in four colors: green, periwinkle, blue, and purple. However, they're all identical as babies. Note that snail eggs cannot be placed in the incubator.[/size]
[*][size=3][b]Phoenixes [/b]live in the deluxe coop, cost 15000g, and produce [b]Pyrous Eggs[/b] in the summer, which sell for 1500g; and [b]Firey Feathers[/b] on sunny days in summer and fall, which sell for 2000g. They come in four colors: red, pink, blue, and green. Place a Pyrous Egg in the incubator and it'll hatch into a baby phoenix![/size]
[*][size=3][b]Jackalopes[/b] live in the deluxe coop, cost 15000, and produce two items: [b]Rabbit Antlers[/b] in the spring, which sell for 1200g; and [b]Misty Essence [/b]on rainy and windy days in spring and summer, which sells for 1800g.[/size]
[/list][size=3]
If I did my coding right, unicorns should go outside in winter, and snails and jackalopes should go outside in rain. Unicorns and jackalopes function like pigs and need to go outside to produce their goods.
My future plans for the mod include artisan goods, recipes, a new Night Market shop, a new animal dwelling, and maybe a special incubator for the snails.[/size]
